title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.21 (versions follow prime numbers; 521 after 509): she imagines the answer, not the information. Her imagination (a word gives its place to another holding the same role) worked only while she improvised; now it also works in the answer she weaves. Answering someone, the window it reads is their talk alone: a word of her answer may change only if their talk says it, and only into another word of their talk; what came from a book stays as she read it. An answer whose every word a kept one already says is no longer added. Measured on five phrases in a hidden copy: all answered in 6 to 34 seconds; in that run she imagined in none of the five. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.21: imagina la respuesta, no la información. Prototipo de investigación.
